0022600109.text: Dallas (1-1) hosts San Antonio (0-1) in the Mavericks' third game of the season, with Dallas 3rd in the Southwest and half a game back and San Antonio 5th in the Southwest and one game back, while the Mavericks sit 8th in the West and the Spurs 11th. Dallas will be without Cooper Flagg (out, shoulder soreness; 32.0 points and 32.9 minutes per game this season) and Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), and Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Jett Howard (calf soreness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after Dallas lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
